title: Hostelify
summary: A Smart Hostel Allocation & Optimization System that assigns rooms fairly and automatically, with no paid APIs.
highlights: Multi-level priority engine: PWD → outside-NCR → zone/distance → student ID
Zone-based fairness: farthest states get highest priority
Hard constraints (gender, capacity) plus soft scoring (hostel, year, course)
PIN-based NCR detection and free Haversine distance calculation
Secure admin login (SHA-256) and double-run protection

title: DawaSarthi
summary: A mobile-first PWA that scans medicine strips and prescriptions, gives a Green/Amber/Red trust card, and alerts caregivers when a dose is missed.
highlights: Vision LLM reads strip/box/prescription into an editable form, with low-confidence fields flagged
Deterministic rules engine decides risk (expiry, batch, strip vs box mismatch, community reports)
TinyFish web agent checks official CDSCO batch alerts and verifies MRP online (read-only)
Smart reminders with push, plus caregiver escalation via SMS/WhatsApp after patient consent
Prescription mode: 1-0-1 patterns auto-convert to a full dose schedule
